items.source:
Abstract base class for URL-based views. Provides a consistent way of
holding the URL that a View wraps, in the form of a "url" bean property.
items.translation: 基于 URL 的视图的抽象基类。提供了一种一致的方式来持有视图所包装的 URL，形式为"url"bean 属性。

items.source: Constructor for use as a bean.
items.translation: 用作 Bean 的构造函数。

items.source: Create a new AbstractUrlBasedView with the given URL.
items.translation: 创建一个具有给定 URL 的新 `AbstractUrlBasedView`。

items.source: Check whether the resource for the configured URL actually exists.
items.translation: 检查配置 URL 对应的资源是否实际存在。

items.source: Return the URL of the resource that this view wraps.
items.translation: 返回该视图所包装资源的 URL。

items.source:
Set the URL of the resource that this view wraps.
The URL must be appropriate for the concrete View implementation.
items.translation: 设置此视图所包装资源的 URL。URL 必须适用于具体的 View 实现。
`toString` 在类 `AbstractView` 中

items.source: false if the resource exists false if we know that it does not exist
items.translation: false 如果资源存在 false 如果我们知道它不存在

items.source: locale - the desired Locale that we're looking for
items.translation: locale - 我们期望查找的所需区域设置 (Locale)

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的 `BeanFactory` 在设置所有 bean 属性并满足 `BeanFactoryAware`、`ApplicationContextAware` 等接口后调用。

items.source: Deferred check whether the resource for the configured URL actually exists.
items.translation: 延迟检查配置 URL 对应的资源是否实际存在。

items.source: Set the URL of the resource that this view wraps.
items.translation: 设置此视图所包装资源的 URL。

items.source: Exception - in the event of misconfiguration (such as failure to set an essential property) or if initialization fails for any other reason
items.translation: Exception - 在配置错误（例如未设置必需属性）或因任何其他原因导致初始化失败的情况下

items.source: Exception - if the resource exists but is invalid (for example, could not be parsed)
items.translation: Exception - 如果资源存在但无效（例如，无法解析）
